engine: Raw MT5 bars are converted to Heikin-Ashi and EVERY rule runs on the HA candle: body break, X-Trend, SUPP wick (body or wick crosses last-trade wick), fill level, stop test, trailing, ATR. Raw OHLC is record-only. Histogram stays on real close (matches the MQ5 indicator).
notes: Dashboards draw HA candles only. engine_mode in bridge_status.json is computed fresh each write. Status file rename retries on WinError 5.
